title: Chapter 3: The Water Mansion
paragraphs: Seeing the Turtle Shell, Chen Mobai felt a faint ache return to the healed wound on his right hand.At this point, dear readers, please remember our domain: sto55.com.
Here's what happened.

Half a month earlier, he had just broken through to the Fifth-Stage of Qi Refinement. His superstitious mother, overjoyed and eager for him to excel in the upcoming college entrance exams, took him back to their ancestral home deep in the mountains to offer incense at a supposedly very efficacious temple.

As he was lighting the incense, some damned fool pushed him from behind. Staggering to regain his balance, he reached out and gripped a Turtle Shell that had been placed as an offering before the deity's statue.

But the shell, blackened by decades of smoke and grime, wasn't exactly clean. A sharp edge of the carapace sliced open Chen Mobai's right hand, leading to a severe infection. Weakened to the point of collapse, he had no choice but to spend half a month in the hospital.

Naturally, his mother wouldn't let this slide, given that her precious son had been hospitalized. She had a heated argument with the temple's presiding cultivator, demanding a refund of the 188 Merit Points she had spent on the "First Incense Offering."

But the old cultivator was no pushover, or perhaps the temple was simply too poor. No matter how Chen Mobai's mother argued, he refused to budge, offering only two Evil-Warding Talismans as compensation.
Faced with a worthy opponent and ultimately realizing he was in the wrong, the old cultivator finally relented slightly.
He allowed Chen Mobai's indignant mother to take the turtle shell, claiming she would burn it to dispel the bad luck clinging to her son.
Yet, the turtle shell remains unburned to this day.

Open fires are strictly prohibited within the city. All discarded and unusable resources are to be recycled, processed through special methods, and buried by Earth Masters within the Earth Vein Spiritual Pivots, maintaining the Diyuan Star Spiritual Energy's generation and circulation cycle.
Only companies and organizations with approved Alchemy and Artifact Refining licenses are permitted to use fire within the city.
Chen Mobai rolled his eyes, got up, and prepared to toss the turtle shell into the trash, hoping the Earth Masters would bury this unlucky thing tomorrow.
But as his hand touched the shell, a flash of silver light pulsed through the air.
Caught off guard, Chen Mobai was enveloped in the silver radiance and vanished from the room.
He wasn't sure how much time had passed.
Chen Mobai's consciousness returned to his body, and he slowly climbed to his feet.
After surveying his surroundings, he realized he was no longer in his own room but inside a mysterious Cave Abode.
He couldn't pinpoint the Cave Abode's location, but he was certain of one thing:
He was underwater.
Looking up, he saw a shimmering blue expanse.
The entire Cave Abode was enclosed by a thin, semi-elliptical barrier of light. Fish and crabs that bumped into the barrier in the water were repelled as if they had struck rubber.
After waiting nearly ten minutes without any senior cultivators appearing, Chen Mobai slowly turned to examine his surroundings.
Upon closer inspection, he determined that this was a small underwater Cave Abode.

The area where he stood appeared to be the Front Hall. In each of the four corners, there was a pedestal with an array flag inserted into it. Combined with the central array flag pedestal behind him, these formed a simple Water-Repelling Array.

Fortunately, Chen Mobai had paid attention in his array formation classes. He recognized this as a Second-Tier Mid-Grade array, which, in addition to gathering spiritual energy, repelling water, concealment, and defense, possessed no offensive capabilities.

Following the principles he had learned in school, Chen Mobai cautiously probed the array. After roughly an hour of thorough examination, he finally confirmed its safety and breathed a sigh of relief.
Satisfied that the Cave Abode was not a death trap at every turn, Chen Mobai waited another half-hour before venturing further.
The Cave Abode proved to be quite small. Beyond the easily visible Front Hall, there were only three side halls at the rear.

The central side hall likely served as a cultivation chamber. Uncertain whether anyone was inside, Chen Mobai retrieved a Wood Armor Talisman from his pocket, clenching it in his palm—his life-saving talisman.
A First-Tier Mid-Grade talisman, once activated, it could withstand attacks from cultivators at the Sixth Layer of Qi Refinement.
With the talisman in hand, Chen Mobai felt a sliver of reassurance.
He then produced a coin and gently rolled it across the floor toward the side hall's entrance.
Just as the coin reached the threshold, a flash of eerie blue lightning erupted, vaporizing the jade-like coin into a wisp of spiritual mist.
Witnessing this, Chen Mobai's heart ached with regret.
This one-yuan coin was equivalent to one Merit Point.

These coins were forged from pulverized, desiccated Spirit Stones mixed with other jade, mineral, and metallic components. Each coin was infused with one unit of Spiritual Energy Value and marked with a talisman for counterfeiting prevention, serving as the fundamental currency unit of Diyuan Star.
Chen Mobai received only five yuan a week in pocket money. After painstakingly earning some extra income crafting Talisman Paper, he had managed to save up eighty Merit Points in his private stash.
Now that he had lost a coin, he hesitated.

After waiting a while longer, the triggered Restriction on the central side hall remained silent. Chen Mobai couldn't restrain himself any longer. Frantically searching his pockets, he found this coin was the only tool available for testing. With a pang of regret, he reluctantly rolled it toward the remaining left and right side halls.
Two distinctly different sound effects and visual phenomena widened Chen Mobai's eyes in astonishment.
The Restriction on the left side hall's door was identical to the central hall's, triggering a burst of azure electrical energy that instantly vaporized the coin.
But the Restriction on the right side hall's door behaved completely differently. It manifested a shimmering, cerulean wave, like ripples in water, that gently pushed the coin back.
Chen Mobai shifted his body aside to let the coin roll back without hitting him.

Chen Mobai waited until the coin had rolled to a stop, then retrieved another and precisely struck the first. Only after confirming that no residual Restriction power lingered on the coin did he pocket it.
He approached the door of the right-side hall and carefully probed it several times. Only after confirming that the Restriction posed no immediate danger did he begin attempting to break it.

However, Chen Mobai possessed no talismans designed for breaking Restrictions. His cultivation technique was merely the Five Elements Internal Cultivation Technique taught at the school, intended solely for foundational training.

If only I'd bought that Water Sword Talisman I've been eyeing for so long,he thought regretfully. His shopping cart on the Immortal Sect Network's trading market contained numerous items he wished to acquire.
Among them was a Water Sword Talisman, a First-Tier Mid-Grade talisman worth 30 Merit Points, perfectly suited for his Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement cultivation.

Sensing the strength of the water-wave Restriction on the side hall door, Chen Mobai estimated it to be roughly equivalent to his Wood Armor Talisman. A Water Sword Talisman, he reasoned, should be enough to break it.
His mind raced, exhausting every bit of his knowledge, but Chen Mobai found himself utterly at a loss.

He could only return to the Water Abode's main hall, sit on the Central Array Flag Pedestal where he had awakened, and meditate to recover the Magic Power he had expended probing the Water Wave Restriction.
As soon as he began meditating, he jolted upright in shock. He pulled out his phone and opened the Spiritual Energy concentration testing app.
Spiritual Energy Value: 60
"This is actually a Second-Tier Mid-Grade Spiritual Vein!"

Chen Mobai's anxiety deepened. This Water Abode couldn't just be the villa of some wealthy family; it was likely a Cave Abode belonging to a cultivator of a higher tier than himself. If they discovered an intruder like him here, they certainly wouldn't be pleased.
"How did I even get here? ...Wait, the Turtle Shell..."
Chen Mobai realized the crucial detail. He scoured the entire accessible Front Hall of the Water Abode, even overturning the potted plants, but the Turtle Shell remained elusive.
"I'm done for! How am I going to explain this to my parents?!"
After another hour of anxious waiting, Chen Mobai checked the time. Realizing his parents would soon be home from work, he had no choice but to resort to his last resort.
He hoped the Immortal Sect's Law Enforcement Cultivators could track his phone's location and rescue him from this Water Abode.
